expression:
http.host eq "mcp.trychannel3.com"
and len(http.request.headers["x-api-key"]) == 0
and len(http.request.headers["authorization"]) == 0
and not ip.src in {160.79.104.0/21}
and not cf.tls_client_auth.cert_verified
